status_summary: Executive Order 14221, signed 2025-02-25, directs agencies to make healthcare prices clearer and more actionable. The CY 2026 outpatient payment final rule, published 2025-11-25 and effective 2026-01-01 with enforcement from 2026-04-01, requires hospitals to post percentile allowed amounts drawn from remittance data, an attestation and a named senior official, and offers a 35 percent penalty reduction for waiving a hearing. The CY 2027 proposed rule of 2026-07-07 requests information on standardizing hospital price data, and a Transparency in Coverage final rule for health plans, published 2026-10-06, is effective 2026-12-07. None of the documents read adds quality measures to hospital price disclosures.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14221, Making America Healthy Again by Empowering Patients With Clear, Accurate, and Actionable Healthcare Pricing Information, signed (published 2025-02-28).
CMS finalizes hospital price transparency changes in the CY 2026 OPPS rule: allowed-amount reporting from remittance data, attestation and senior official, penalty reduction option.
CY 2027 outpatient proposed rule requests information on improving comparability and standardization of hospital price transparency data.
Treasury, Labor and HHS publish the Transparency in Coverage final rule for group health plans, effective 2026-12-07.
